name: tarbfheis
text: tarbfheis, with the variants tarbhfheis and tarb feis, names the Irish term MacKillop records for the bull feast. The phrase translates as bull feast. The full record of the bull-feast tradition sits under the headword bull, with related coverage under kingship.

attributes.attribute: Irish for bull feast; pointer to bull headword and kingship

okr.objective: tarbfheis is a MacKillop signpost for the bull headword.
key_results: Signpost cites bull as the canonical headword.
Variants include tarbhfheis and tarb feis.
